name: Newtonite-Assignment-for-SDE
description: Newtonite Assignment for SDE - Interactive Visual Reasoning Assessment Platform & Examination Engine

paragraphs: A modern, production-grade web application built for the Software Development Engineer (SDE) technical assessment.
🌐 Live Interactive Demo • 📁 Project Structure • ⚡ Core Features • 🚀 Quick Start
features: Practice Mode: Provides instant answer verification with custom glowing indicators (#10b981 emerald for correct, #f43f5e rose for incorrect) and contextual, step-by-step reasoning guides.
Exam Mode: Simulates actual proctored test conditions. Answer selections are registered securely without immediate reveals, culminating in a detailed accuracy and performance report upon completion.
Programmatically extracted 84 high-resolution diagram assets and 400+ paragraphs from binary .docx source files.
Normalized complex visual reasoning questions into a unified JavaScript data layer (quizdata.js).
Data Rectification: Programmatically resolved and completed 13 questions that had incomplete or omitted answer keys in the original source through algorithmic deduction and spatial reasoning.
